::: {.course-lead}
POLI 210 introduces probability, statistical inference, data analysis in R,
and the foundations of simple linear regression. We treat reproducibility as
part of statistical reasoning: shared work is written in Quarto, managed with
Git, and checked through GitHub.
:::

::: {.callout-important title="Seminar 2: Probability and simulation"}
**Wednesday, September 9, 1:30-4:20 p.m.**

Classroom and Office Building 1, Room 205

Read **PSD §§2.1, 2.2, and 2.4** and bring your laptop. A1 is due at 1:30 p.m.
See the [meeting page](meetings/02-probability/index.qmd) for lecture slides and
R examples. Conditional probability and Bayes' rule are reserved for next week.
:::
